Hi Marcus — Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This project sounds like a great fit for my experience building realtime dashboards and integrating with REST APIs.

I can deliver: realtime data visualizations (I have experience with D3 and Recharts and can recommend the best fit), authentication and role-based access, responsive layouts for tablet/desktop, and a dark mode. For a 4-week timeline I can provide an initial UI prototype in week 1, core charts and API integration by week 3, and final polish + testing in week 4.

A few quick questions to confirm scope and provide a firm estimate:
1) Do you have API docs or a staging endpoint I can review? Any realtime protocol details (WebSocket, SSE, polling)?
2) Do you have a preferred charting library, or are you open to recommendations? (I typically use D3 for custom visuals or Recharts for faster development.)
3) How many distinct user roles and major screens should I plan for initially?
4) Will you require ongoing maintenance after launch?

If it sounds good, I’m happy to hop on a 20–30 minute call to go over requirements and timeline. I’m available next week on Tue/Thu afternoons (CT). Thanks — looking forward to chatting.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer — TechCorp Inc.
Portfolio: jordanmitchell.dev
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/jordanmitchell
